protocol.scope: Exploratory diagnostic motivated by inspection of the last confirmation. That block is no longer a fresh test for this change. Fixed settings, no grid search. No detector/ID changes. Never replaces an existing map point. New points are always hollow estimates, not visible contacts. Hidden coordinate accuracy is unknown.

original.scope: Same initial dancer ID required. Missing or wrong-ID outputs count as misses; held/interpolated outputs assessed separately. Uncertain labels excluded from visibility/F1.

weak_estimates.scope: Same initial dancer ID required. Missing or wrong-ID outputs count as misses; held/interpolated outputs assessed separately. Uncertain labels excluded from visibility/F1.
